meta.title: Switch scrypt to wallycore
meta.body_summary: Switch scrypt implementation to wallycore where available, document fallback slowdown, and remove wallycore from minimal requirements.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex generated a small PR to switch scrypt to wallycore; closed by author shortly after without review or explanation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 50 changed lines across 3 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a minor dependency-switch performance PR, but was closed without merge, suggesting the author decided not to proceed despite the small size.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or PR discussion captured in dataset; author closed PR without any review interaction.
review_details.performance_claim: wallycore.scrypt is faster than pylibscrypt; fallback yields ~20% slowdown.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A small, low-risk library dependency switch closed by the author without any interaction; suggests a process gap where agent-created PRs may be opened and immediately closed without maintainer investment.

core_change_summary.description: In lib/pylibscrypt/__init__.py, added preference for wallycore.scrypt when wallycore is available, with fallback to pylibscrypt and performance comment. Updated docs/INSTALL.md and requirements-full.txt to reflect the change.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: remove wallycore from minimal requirements, add fallback logic in __init__.py with documentation.
Second commit: add source hash for wallycore in requirements-full.txt.
